title: DeWALT 36V Mower kit ($1399) + Free 5 Piece Mixed Combo ($1699) + Hedge Trimmer ($269) + Blower ($249) via Redemption @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: DeWALT 36V Mower kit ($1399) + Free 5 Piece Mixed Combo ($1699) + Hedge Trimmer ($269) + Blower ($249) via Redemption @ Bunnings

[Carbon Door] How does option 1 connect with the double redemption?
[CharcoaI] Yeah, unless I'm reading it wrong - are you saying the $1399 mower, includes the a free $1699 combo kit (DCZ507T2-XE) AND 2 other free garden tools?
[JHBay] And possibly free batteries too?!?!?!
That is how I read it yes.
[JHBay] 5 piece combo kit page has the batteries listed as available for online redemption.
[Japius] the images on the product pages dont match the wording on the promo page, i bet they messed up the promo page and the only bonuses with the mowers are the hedge trimmer and blower.
[Random Stranger] The T&C for the hedge trimmer and blower is as below, which you can see the redemption date period is not the same as this super short promo for the 5 pieces tool set. So I’m guessing it’s valid?
“ Instant Instore Bonus;
DCMBL562N-XE :1185020 18V XR AXIAL BLOWER SKIN + DCMHT562N-XE :1185021 18V XR HEDGE TRIMMER SKIN. T&Cs apply, see GUARANTEEDTOUGH.com.au. Offer valid on purchases made between 01.09.2026 to 30.11.2026. Open to AU res 18+. Ends: 11:59pm AU 30.11.2026, or once stock runs out, whichever is first to occur. Max 1 claim p/transaction in store only. Not available online.”
[hippyhippy] My god. The people working the toolshop are going to be confused like never before in the history of mankind
[bobthereviewer] Potentially price match the mower at Melbourne Mower Centre to bring it down to $1052 for the first option?
[BeefBiryani] I thought 54V was the minimum for a battery operated mower.
[UncleRico] Sounds great value, if they all stack. Good luck!
[RichardF89] The review for the $1.4k mower is terrible.
[nitecafe] I was close to biting the bullet but looks like the online reviews for the XR mowers are not that good
[Anthrox] for this kinda money go to total tools and look for a ego power deals its great gear.
each store has pre package deal boxes they dont put on their website one guy told me they dont always have them but the other week i ended up getting a 7.5 battery a 52cm mower, muilt tool head with the edger and line trimmer for 1500 was 300 off and im also getting a rebate battery and possible a blower so maybe another 400 bucks of gear cut my lawn same day and it looks great trimmer is so much better than petrol
[klatscho] Good deal if you end up getting that blower!
I helped myself to a Greenworks 46cm self propelled mower plus 2 batteries and a multi tool head plus trimmer, saw and whipper snippet for about 1k. Was looking at Dewalt for a long time, but the value is unbeatable and kit is sturdy and works like a charm
[Benson] Where is any link or pictures for this redemption?
And instant instore redeem:
DeWALT 18V/54V XR 6.0Ah 5 Piece Mixed Voltage Combo Kit DCZ507T2-XE ($1699):
https://www.bunnings.com.au/dewalt-18v-54v-xr-6-0ah-5-piece-…

[Nitrollparty] Thanks for sharing, as an employee I always find out about redemption offers on ozbargin first rather than my employer telling me.
Saves me being a dumb c**t towards the customer now
[Betrayal90] Either i can't figure it out or im not sure how you are seeing the combos link with the mower? Everything i read its only the blower and trimmer ?
Edit: I see now when you follow deal link
